name: example-motionsites-fastshot-hero
title: Fastshot AI Hero
description: A restrained AI app-builder hero with misty lake video, dark glass composer, responsive action controls, proof logos, mobile navigation, and precise one-shot entrance motion.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 克制的 AI 应用生成器 Hero，包含晨雾湖景视频、深色玻璃输入卡、响应式操作区、客户标识、移动导航和一次性入场动效。
description_i18n.en: A restrained AI app-builder hero with misty lake video, dark glass composer, responsive action controls, proof logos, mobile navigation, and precise one-shot entrance motion.

query.en: Create an AI app-builder landing hero using the Fastshot motion template, then replace the brand and copy while preserving its composer layout and responsive choreography.
query.zh-CN: 使用 Fastshot 动效模板创建 AI 应用生成器落地页 Hero，替换品牌和文案，同时保留输入卡布局与响应式动效编排。
